# Dependency Repair

Use this skill for Maven dependency and runtime classpath evidence.

Look for:

- Missing artifacts or repositories.
- Scope issues that remove runtime classes.
- Jakarta/Javax dependency mismatch.
- Spring Boot dependency management drift.
- Maven profile classpath mismatches.

Propose dependency changes for human review only.
